We share food often between us because normally only one of us has lunch or we’re agreeing to split or whatever. Then , one of my others friends sat down, asked to try one. I agreed and gave them one. Then, friend three, calling her M, walked over, dumping her bag on the table. She then , literally lunging over the table at my food. I guess me refusing her as she attempted to ask again is borderline assholery. Reddit , AITA?
